name: priogrid
description: Chat-driven weekly planning for Todoist, packaged as a Codex plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Plan the week through Codex using Todoist as the backend
interface.longDescription: priogrid is a Codex-first weekly planning layer for Todoist. It keeps Todoist canonical, stores planning metadata in a dedicated Todoist project, and lets the agent review priorities, choose active work, create chunks, schedule tasks, and sync changes without a web UI.
defaultPrompt: Review my current priorities using priogrid.
